[5] (ran5_tdoc_chunks R5-180207, sim=0.6542)
To RAN4 group RAN5 asks RAN4 to consider which requirements should be validated in a per panel basis and which are sufficient to validate at only one direction. It is also necessary to consider if a per panel requirement is carried out with explicit knowledge of the panel location or if this is implicitly covered through measurements at sufficient locations on the sphere as to ensure each panel has been tested. Lastly, it is recommended to also consider the test time impact of any additional requirements resulting from additional antenna panel testing. Also RAN5 respectfully asks RAN4 to review the “Assumed metric” specified in Table 1 in R5-180094 and finalize the metrics. Discussion: r4 was presented on Thu. Decision: The document was approved.
